items.name: Zeus Gas Plant and Coastal Bend NGL Fractionator construction
items.claim: The company announced construction of the 300 MMCFD Zeus Gas Plant in the Permian Basin and a 100 thousand barrels per day Coastal Bend NGL Fractionator in Corpus Christi.
items.source_excerpt: Announced the construction of the 300 MMCFD Zeus Gas Plant in the Permian Basin and a 100 thousand barrels per day (“MBD”) Coastal Bend NGL Fractionator in Corpus Christi.

items.name: CPChem Golden Triangle and Ras Laffan polymers projects
items.claim: Chevron Phillips Chemical progressed the Golden Triangle Polymers Project in Orange, Texas, and the Ras Laffan Polymers Project in Qatar, with full operations expected in 2027.
items.source_excerpt: Chevron Phillips Chemical Company LLC (“CPChem”) progressed the Golden Triangle Polymers Project in Orange, Texas, and Ras Laffan Polymers Project in Qatar, with full operations expected in 2027.

notes: Q2 2026 results release names a midstream and a chemicals (CPChem JV) project pipeline; both carry dated disclosure with at least one quantified figure.
